hero.subtitle: Available on macOS and Windows today. Telegram remote access works from any phone; native mobile is on the roadmap.

steps.title: Install Fluso
steps.copy: Download the Mac or Windows app. Mac installs from a DMG; Windows runs from the signed installer and updates quietly in the background.

steps.title: Build project recall
steps.copy: Connect your apps and drop in your files. Fluso starts indexing the context, shows readable sync history, and prompts you when a connector needs reconnecting.

steps.title: Work from anywhere
steps.copy: Use the desktop app at your desk. Message Fluso from anywhere via Telegram.

download.moreOptions: Intel Mac, version history, install help

guarantee.label: Guarantee
guarantee.body: Signed installers, quiet background updates, offline recovery, and a dedicated EU sandbox. By downloading Fluso, you agree to our <terms>terms of service</terms>.
